name: Chemical /Urea Storage (reinforced concrete 15x9x7)
description: Evidence: BS EN 1992-3 explicitly covers concrete containment of liquids or granular solids (urea), plus RC design/execution standards and generic JKR rates; no storage-building cost read.

specifications.basis: Line item from the Alaska GEG WBS/BOQ; no sourced numeric specification found.

source.note: Work package supplied by owner; not a technical source.

sources.note: JML scope: task force work - piping, mechanical, structural and E&I; industrial plant; client Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd.

gaps.why: No urea-storage design specification, capacity or published cost found; BS EN 1992-3 excludes hazardous-material leakage-risk structures and gas tightness, so applicability to stored chemicals is unverified.
gaps.next_action: Confirm stored product and design code (e.g. bundled chemical storage) from the project specification; source a comparable chemical-storage building rate.
